publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26koz (AT2026zyg) in galaxy 2MASXJ20352885+5135274 at magnitude, m_o = 18.05 +/- 0.12. At a distance of 46 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD 61280.27 (2026-08-28.27) with an absolute magnitude, M = -16.5 +/- 0.1. The last non-detection (5-sigma; unforced) was on MJD 61279.03. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
